sources.title: Sao10K/14B-Qwen2.5-Kunou-v1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: I do not really have anything planned for this model other than it being a generalist, and Roleplay Model? It was just something made and planned in minutes. This is the little sister variant, the small 14B version. Kunou's the name of an OC I worked on for a couple of years, for a... fanfic. mmm ...

sources.title: 14B-Qwen2.5-Kunou-v1 Open-Source Role-Playing Model - Achieve Excellent ...
sources.snippet: 14B-Qwen2.5-Kunou-v1 is a general-purpose role-playing model with a rather casual development plan. It is a small-scale 14B version and uses high-quality and refined datasets, showing quite excellent performance.
